notes: The starter search, narrowed to one board: full-time roles posted in the last 30 days, from Lever only. Everything else is the same — no keywords, no city, no seniority, no salary floor — so what it shows is what one ATS has, uncoloured by the other two. Every unknown is still included: a posting that did not publish its employment type or its date is not excluded for the blank.
